highlights.description: Initial release of AIStandards.io website for AI standards listing, commentary, and implementation tracking
TRON-inspired dark theme with semantic identity colors (cyan=human, orange=agent, purple=workload)
Go CLI tooling for data validation, JSON schema generation, and Awesomely markdown export

added.description: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4 web application
TRON-inspired theme with semantic identity colors for humans, agents, and workloads
Standards listing page with category filters (agent, identity, general)
Standard detail pages with specification links, website URLs, and SDK links
Implementations listing page showing GitHub repositories
Implementation detail pages with architecture levels and supported standards
Go types for Standard, Implementation, and Language with JSON schema annotations
Go validation package for cross-validating standards and implementations
Awesomely markdown export for generating Awesome-list style documentation
CLI tool with validate, schema, and awesome commands
StandardLink type with language support for SDK/demo links
Language SVG icons for Go, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript
SDK and resource links for ID-JAG, AAuth, and AIMS standards
Unified lit-navbar component for cross-site navigation
MkDocs Material theme CSS for documentation sites
JSON schemas generated from Go types for data validation
GitHub Pages SPA support with 404.html fallback

changed.description: Card styling updated with tinted backgrounds and always-visible colored borders
Card border brightness increased to 50% opacity for better visibility

fixed.description: Navbar offset styles for MkDocs integration
Navbar IIFE build for cross-origin loading compatibility

build.description: npm workspaces monorepo with apps/web structure
Vite plugin for GitHub Pages support (404.html, .nojekyll, CNAME)
Production output to /docs directory for GitHub Pages deployment
